title: 'We are Gen Z' row: Army veteran's crowdfund offer for woman to serve in Siachen
content: A retired Army officer criticized a tourist's viral rant at a Kargil checkpoint. He stated her behavior unfairly portrayed the younger generation and created division. The officer offered to crowdfund her salary to serve in challenging locations. He defended security personnel and emphasized Kashmiris' equal partnership in India. The incident occurred during VIP movement which caused temporary traffic restrictions.

title: BNP's Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir elected 23rd president of Bangladesh
content: Alamgir secured 255 votes in Thursday's presidential election held at the Jatiya Sangsad, Bangladesh's Parliament. His rival, Oli Ahmed, the candidate backed by an 11-party opposition alliance led by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami and the National Citizen Party (NCP), received 88 votes. The voting took place between 2 pm and 5 pm local time under the supervision of chief election commissioner AMM Nasir Uddin.

title: What Jeff Dean, whose Google exit sparked $200B loss in a day, has to say on Gemini
content: In the wake of his departure from Google, Jeff Dean, a seasoned figure in the tech giant, has openly discussed his faith in the Gemini AI models and his next venture. His exit led to a noticeable dip in Alphabet’s market cap, but Dean emphasized the effectiveness of small, focused teams in AI innovation. He is also the founder of Discovery Loop, a new AI startup with Google’s backing.

title: ‘Don’t go chasing the IPL’: Pujara’s plea for Manav Suthar after Galle heroics
content: Cheteshwar Pujara has encouraged young spinner Manav Suthar to prioritize his development in Test cricket, emphasizing the importance of maintaining his natural bowling style for the longer format instead of adapting to white-ball games. Having performed admirably in his first two Tests, Pujara sees the flighted deliveries of Suthar as essential for success. Recently, India celebrated a notable World Test Championship triumph.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: At the Silicon Valley International Festival, Taiwanese innovators caught the global spotlight with remarkable inventions. A ten-year-old prodigy took home a prestigious award for crafting an AI-driven electronic nose capable of detecting hazardous substances and potentially stopping disease outbreaks. This year, Taiwanese competitors celebrated a landmark achievement, claiming twenty-four gold medals and numerous honors, showcasing their ingenuity and practical solutions that captivated both judges and audiences.

title: California teen finds blocking one pathway stops cancer cells from spreading
content: Jonathan Yan, an 18-year-old student from California, studied data from 479 human cancer cell lines to understand how cancer spreads. His research found that the transsulfuration pathway was highly active in metastatic cancers. When he blocked the pathway in cancer cell lines, the cells stopped spreading, pointing to a possible area for further research into cancer metastasis.

title: Over 90% of fresh US broccoli comes from drought-hit California
content: The ongoing drought in California threatens the broccoli supply of the entire nation. Estimates indicate that shipment reductions could exceed twenty percent if conditions worsen. Experts propose that by growing more broccoli on the East Coast, costs related to supply chains could decrease and food miles reduced, leading to a more robust and dependable broccoli market across the country.

title: Gwyneth Paltrow is hosting a private dinner for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman; what invite says
content: Gwyneth Paltrow is hosting a private, off-the-record dinner for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman at her Amagansett home on August 29, Puck News reports. The Goop founder has invested in AI startups since 2021, from Forethought AI to Speechify, and her podcast is increasingly AI-focused. The pivot follows Goop layoffs in May that sources attributed to profitability and a shift to AI workflows.

title: 'She cheated on me': SBI banker kills wife, sister; posts chilling WhatsApp status
content: A State Bank of India employee allegedly shot his estranged wife outside her workplace. He then reportedly returned home and shot his younger sister. The employee then turned the gun on himself, ending the tragic sequence. A WhatsApp status accusing his wife of cheating was found. Police are investigating the marital dispute and the events.

title: Spain break 23-year-old cricket record held by Ponting and Waugh's Australia
content: Spain are currently playing in the Men's T20 World Cup Sub Regional Europe Qualifiers in Southern Finland and have won all their matches in the tournament so far. Their latest victory came against Bulgaria on August 18, when they chased down a target of 60 in just 29 deliveries, winning by nine wickets.

title: Watch: ‘Modi Chalisa’ at Press Club of India sparks row; act draws clarification
content: In response to a viral video, the Press Club of India confirmed that the event featuring an aarti for a Prime Minister Narendra Modi statue was not sanctioned by them. The hall had been rented for a press conference by an external organization, but the terms of the rental were breached. The club took immediate action to stop the event, issuing a clarification via social media about their involvement.

title: Homes struggle, factories thrive: How AI is reshaping the US economy
content: US housing starts fell sharply in July, reaching their lowest point since November 2022.  Existing home purchase contracts also declined, hitting their weakest level since January.  High borrowing costs and limited inventory continue to impact housing affordability and sales.  Meanwhile, US factory output reached its highest level in over four years.  This manufacturing growth was driven by strong investment in artificial intelligence and related industries.

title: England pacers cut Pakistan Test match ball in half; here's why
content: Robinson took 5 for 51 and Tongue claimed 5 for 46 as Pakistan were bowled out for 171 on the first day of England's first Test under Joe Root's second stint as full-time captain following Ben Stokes' retirement from international cricket.

title: No home to return to: Assam’s flood victims face harder fight after waters recede
content: Assam's floodwaters have receded, but families face immense challenges rebuilding their lives.  Destruction of homes and essential supplies marks the beginning of a new struggle.  The government is assessing damage and providing initial financial assistance to affected households.  Restoring livelihoods and infrastructure remains a significant hurdle for many residents.  The long-term recovery process continues as the state addresses ongoing flood and erosion issues.

title: ‘Why is she wearing shorts’: How family outing at Pune fort turned into assault
content: Police registered a case against eight members after an assault.  The incident occurred at Sinhagad Fort following an argument over a girl's attire.  The group allegedly questioned and then physically assaulted the complainant and his family.  Similar complaints were also received from other visitors to the historical fort.  Authorities have launched a search to apprehend the eight accused individuals.

title: 'RSS believes it knows the truth for everyone': Rahul attacks Sangh over ideology
content: Speaking at the "Hara Bhara Swaraj: A Tribute to Rajiv Gandhi's Vision" programme, the Gandhi Scion described the ideological contest in India as a deeper struggle over how people understand themselves, freedom and their place in society. The Congress leader also drew a distinction between the RSS's worldview and Mahatma Gandhi's idea of 'Swaraj', saying no organisation or individual could claim to know what is true for another person.

title: NSE shares may trade on its platform under 'permitted-to-trade' route: Report
content: The National Stock Exchange is considering a groundbreaking move to trade its own shares directly on its platform, potentially skipping the need for additional approval from Sebi. By leveraging its existing 'permitted-to-trade' mechanism, the NSE could facilitate trading of shares already listed on other recognized exchanges, making NSE shares available for its own trading after an initial listing elsewhere.

title: India, Japan deepen defence ties with maritime security pact as China challenge looms
content: India and Japan's defense ministers met to expand their strategic partnership. They signed an agreement enhancing maritime security cooperation between their navies. This pact facilitates information sharing and disaster relief efforts. Both nations are also exploring joint shipbuilding and reciprocal ship repair facilities. Future plans include joint exercises and a defense industry forum.

title: Poonam Pandey defends Govinda amid wife Sunita Ahuja's affair allegations
content: In a surprising turn of events, Poonam Pandey has stepped up to defend Govinda amid his wife Sunita Ahuja's allegations. Pandey firmly supported Govinda, rejecting claims of his involvement with another woman. Meanwhile, Sunita was spotted at a family court with their son Yashvardhan, igniting divorce rumors. However, Govinda's manager later reassured fans that Sunita has decided to withdraw her earlier divorce petition.

title: 'We hope for the players' support': BWF on India Open in Delhi pollution
content: BWF secretary general Thomas Lund defends the India Open's February scheduling despite Delhi's pollution concerns, urges players to support the calendar and outlines the sport's plans for a 15-point scoring system, greater technology use and synthetic shuttlecocks.

title: BWF Worlds: Treesa-Gayatri stun 7th seeds to reach quarters, medal one win away
content: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships quarterfinal spot.  The unseeded Indian pair defeated Japan's seventh seeds in straight games.  Treesa's aggressive play and Gayatri's structural support proved decisive.  This victory marks a significant step in their comeback after Treesa's injury.  A medal is now guaranteed with one more win at the event.

title: 'My best shot': Nasa astronaut shares image of 2025 Maha Kumbh taken from space
content: Astronaut Donald Pettit has unveiled breathtaking photographs of the 2025 Maha Kumbh Mela, captured from the International Space Station. These stunning images showcase the vibrant Hindu pilgrimage, shimmering against the vast darkness of space. The event, held in Prayagraj, attracted millions for ritual bathing, marking it as one of the largest gatherings in human history. This expedition also contributed to ongoing scientific research efforts.

title: No 2800 km dash this time: Qamran Iqbal arrives early, ready for Duleep Trophy challenge
content: Called up less than 24 hours before the Ranji Trophy final, Qamran Iqbal travelled nearly 2,800 km from Srinagar to Hubballi before scoring an unbeaten 160 that helped Jammu and Kashmir win their maiden title. The 24-year-old reflects on the whirlwind journey, J&K's rise and his ambition to shine in the Duleep Trophy. North Zone will take on West Zone at the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (CoE) from Sunday.

title: NCERT recasts political science textbook panel; 4 with RSS links among 20 members
content: NCERT has recast the team for preparing political science textbooks for Classes XI and XII, with one of the two books slated to be ready by Nov. The 20-member panel includes faculty from JNU, DU, IGNOU and NLU Delhi, among others. At least four members have links, past or present, with organisations associated with RSS-BJP.

title: In dry Gujarat, spurious booze kills 6 at party thrown by cop; 25 in hospital
content: Six people died and twenty-five were hospitalized after drinking methanol-spiked liquor.  The incident occurred in Bhavnagar district, with victims consuming liquor from Royal Stag bottles.  Questions arose regarding alleged police reporting delays, prompting an investigation by the State Monitoring Cell.  Patients reported breathlessness and vision loss, with officials warning of kidney complications.  The liquor was manufactured and sold locally in Bhavnagar, and suspects have been detained.

title: US Army eyes mobile K9 howitzer to replace M777; India too shifts towards wheeled artillery
content: The US Army is testing South Korea's K9 Mobile Howitzer for potential replacement of towed systems. This move aligns with India's ongoing artillery modernization efforts under its rationalization plan. India is developing indigenous systems and incorporating local content into foreign designs. Both nations seek enhanced mobility and longer-range artillery capabilities for future conflicts. This shift reflects a global recognition of modern artillery's essential requirements.

title: Why model Rhiya Ahir is in spotlight: Details on education, career

A viral video showed her standing in front of a police van carrying detained protesters at Shivaji Park. Ahir, 27, studied Psychology before pursuing an English Literature degree through distance education. She has also trained extensively in theatre and founded Rhiyasat, a luxury handcrafted apparel label supporting Indian artisans.

title: Bulldozers roll outside Pakistan High Commission in Delhi; barricades removed

This action effectively eliminated the external security perimeter outside the high commission. The Pakistan High Commission is situated within the Chanakyapuri diplomatic enclave.

title: Half of UK homes take longer to sell as buyers adopt ‘wait & see’ approach: Here’s why
content: A significant shift is occurring in the UK housing market, as half of British homes are now taking longer to sell compared to the previous year. Factors such as mortgage market turbulence and uncertainties regarding borrowing costs are causing potential buyers to hesitate. While Scotland presents the quickest sales, other regions are facing frustrating delays, pressured by inflation worries and potential interest rate increases.

title: ‘Strong values around Test cricket’: Gary Kirsten reveals chat with Gambhir

With Gambhir leading India and Kirsten at the helm for Sri Lanka, their aligned perspectives on team strategies emerged. Gambhir's impressive coaching record is complemented by Kirsten's previous support of him, while India recently enjoyed a memorable victory against Sri Lanka in the Galle Test.

title: China puts 'robocops' on traffic duty; a 'Superman' robot claims it can outrun Bolt
content: the 1.88-metre, 98-kg robot, developed by SUPCON Information, is being deployed to handle routine traffic-control duties . it uses cameras, radar and onboard computing to identify helmetless e-bike riders, passengers on ebikes, vehicles crossing stop lines and pedestrians violating signals . the robot has no power to arrest and does not carry a gun .

title: Former Congress MP Sajjan Kumar, convicted in 1984 anti-Sikh riots case, dies at 80
content: former congress MP was serving a life sentence in connection with the 1984 anti-sikh riots in Delhi . he was sentenced to life imprisonment by the Delhi high court on December 17, 2018 in a case involving the killing of five Sikhs and the burning of a gurdwara .

title: Who was Sajjan Kumar? From 3-time Congress MP to 1984 riots convict
content: former congress leader was serving a life sentence in 1984 anti-sikh riots . he was among the close allies of Indira Gandhi's younger son, Sanjay . his political career halted after being accused of rioting former prime minister .

title: How an 18-year-old turned $10 abandoned storage units into a $135,000 business
content: he buys storage units across the tri-state area without knowing exactly what is inside, then sorts through the contents looking for objects that can be resold . the idea grew from a habit he picked up as a child, when he sold books on eBay and held onto discontinued Lego sets . by high school, he was also thinking about college and how he might distinguish himself from applicants with stronger academic records .

title: NEET protests: SC sets up 5-member panel to probe excessive use of force by cops
content: the top court said a five-member panel will be headed by former SC judge justice R Subhash Reddy . the committee will examine allegations of excessive use of force against students during the student march over the NEET paper leak . it will also look into police surveillance, the proportionality of crowd-control measures, and the provision of medical assistance and compensation to victims .

title: Secret Hormuz corridor: How US kept ships, oil moving despite Iran threat
content: the operation allowed 15–20 tankers to move through a southern channel of the strait each night under US military guidance . this carried close to 10 million barrels of oil a day, half the volume that passed through the waterway before the war . the previously unreported operation has provided a crucial channel for keeping oil exports moving at a time when the conflict has severely disrupted one of the world's most important energy routes .

title: Setback for Jharkhand students: HC stays Soren govt's order to cancel JPSC exams
content: government's order to cancel 11th and 13th JPSC exams and appointments stayed . comes days after the government cancelled the JSSC-CGL examination and all recruitment exams conducted by TDPL . chief minister Hemant Soren had announced the cancellation of the 14th and backlog examinations .
